dedup: Same placed unopened-loot/resolved-item ownership chain already accepted; expanding reader to actual consumer is evidence improvement, not a second owner. No new credit for tryLoadLootTable helper or dust/counter fields.
mechanism: Actual brush item fires every10 use ticks at modulo5, server BE brush enforces10tick cooldown; every call extends reset to+40 before cooldown test. First acceptedbrush resolves loot using actor luck/player context and fixed seed, fires GENERATE_LOOT trigger before random selection, keeps first result if multiple, sets lootTable null and dirty. Persistent writer keeps pending table or resolved item only. brushCount/timers omitted; hit_direction network update only not disk writer. Completion at10 drops split random10..30 item count, then forcibly empties remainder, adds world entity without checking success and replaces source block without checking success. Decay after40 subtracts2 then resets at4tick intervals, clears direction/timers at0. Block tick drives decay and unsupported block falls with disableDrop. Brush durability is consumed only when completion boolean true.
limits: Entire3classes actually read; item hurtAndBreak, loot internals, global serialization/runtime not newly audited.
